sections.title: Fast in, fast out
sections.body: A customer drops off a bag of shirts and two dishdashas. Pick the items from your price list, take payment now or at pickup, and print or share the receipt. The starter catalogue comes with wash and fold, dry cleaning and press items, ready for you to edit to your own prices.

sections.title: Deliver back and bill monthly
sections.body: Send finished orders out with a delivery note and keep the proof of handover. Hotels, clinics and offices can run on account and pay monthly, with a clear statement of what is owed. Built in Oman with native OMR and 5% VAT.

faqs.q: Can I price by piece and by kilo?
faqs.a: Yes. Each service has its own unit, so a dishdasha is priced per piece and wash and fold per kilo.

faqs.q: Can I deliver orders to customers?
faqs.a: Yes. The Delivery module adds delivery notes, so you can send orders out and keep proof of handover.

faqs.q: Can a hotel or office pay monthly?
faqs.a: Yes. Leave sales on the customer's account and send one invoice or statement at the end of the month.

faqs.q: Can I send receipts on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. Share any receipt or invoice on WhatsApp or by email.
Sales and Invoicing is free forever. Add POS or Delivery when you need them and pay only for those modules.

ctaTitle: Run your laundry from one counter
ctaSub: Start free with receipts and invoices, then add the POS and deliveries when you are ready.
